raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-17 the source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL rows and no longer updates the original record to REVERSED. The originals stay POSTED and pass the status filter, so reversed transactions are still counted and totals run high for the latest days. Silver should exclude any POSTED transaction that a REVERSAL row points to, which matches the old REVERSED behaviour.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL)"}}
